decision_rule.PASS_SINGLE_QUERY: prefix_set_equal_B AND prefix_set_equal_C true on ALL targets -> tail production may reuse the shipped query with a widened LIMIT (design K1, contract T12)
decision_rule.FALLBACK_TWO_QUERY: any target mismatches -> keep the shipped LIMIT-50 query byte-identical and issue a second LIMIT-D query for the tail, taking tail = [g for g in rows[50:D] if g not in shortlist]; priced ~+2.7-3.0 s/query, bench-only
